title: EVIL
bio: 'EVIL' is an experimental remix of JinnaWoods’ 'It’s True Evil', reworked by QueenServeantDonked. Released on *The Iconic Pop* (2025), the track uses elements of the original but adds avant-garde production and a more chaotic energy.
lyrics: JinnaWoods arrived to the Halloween Party!
Put that dick on your face
Put that dick on your face
